LanguageData.UWU_TraitCostMultiplierDesc: Adjust the material cost of customizing weapons. At 0%, customization is free. Default: {0}%.
LanguageData.UWU_TraitRefundRateDesc: The share of a trait's cost that is returned when the trait is removed. Negative traits cost this share to add or remove instead. Default: {0}%.
LanguageData.UWU_RefundRateNoEffect: The trait refund rate has no effect while the trait cost multiplier is 0%.
LanguageData.UWU_UseRecipeBaseCost: Derive base cost from crafting recipe
LanguageData.UWU_UseRecipeBaseCostDesc: When enabled, the cost of adding a trait will be based on the weapon's crafting recipe. When disabled, every weapon of the same tech level will use the same flat cost, so cheap weapons no longer have cheap traits. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_RarityCostCapDesc: A trait's rarity is how rarely it appears on unique weapons found in the world. Rarer traits cost more, up to this many times their base cost. At 1x, rarity does not affect cost. Default: {0}x.
LanguageData.UWU_ComplexityFloorScaleDesc: Spacer-tech traits will always cost a minimum number of advanced components, even on weapons made without components, such as melee weapons and bows. At 0%, there is no minimum. Default: {0}%.
LanguageData.UWU_CostSettingNoEffect: This setting has no effect while the trait cost multiplier is 0%.
LanguageData.UWU_MinimumQualityDesc: The lowest quality a weapon can have and still be customized. At awful, every weapon qualifies. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_RequireCustomizationResearchDesc: When enabled, a weapon can only be customized after researching {0}, {1} or {2}, depending on its tech level. When disabled, these projects will be hidden from the research window. Default: {3}.
LanguageData.UWU_RequireRecipeResearchDesc: When enabled, a weapon can only be customized once the research needed to craft it is complete. For example, customizing a {0} will require {1}. Default: {2}.
LanguageData.UWU_RequireWorkbenchDesc: When enabled, a weapon must be customized at a workbench of its own tech level. When disabled, any workbench that can craft weapons will do. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_AllowUncraftableDesc: When enabled, weapons that have no crafting recipe can also be customized. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_AllowUltratechDesc: When enabled, ultratech weapons can be customized once {0} is researched. Default: {1}.
LanguageData.UWU_AllowUltratechImpliedDesc: Always enabled while "Allow customizing archotech weapons" is enabled, because both need the same research.
LanguageData.UWU_AllowArchotechDesc: When enabled, archotech weapons can be customized once {0} is researched. Default: {1}.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckEnableDesc: When enabled, customizing a weapon will require crafting skill. The options below set whose skill counts and how much is needed. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckSubjectDesc: The colonist whose skill must meet the requirement.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckSubjectPawnDesc: The colonist ordered to customize the weapon must have the skill themselves.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckSubjectMap: The most skilled colonist on the map
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckSubjectMapDesc: At least one colonist on the weapon's map must have the skill. The colonist doing the work does not need it.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckSubjectWorldDesc: At least one of your colonists must have the skill, wherever they are, including in caravans and transports.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindNoEffect: This setting has no effect while the skill check applies to no one.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindRecipe: Based on the weapon's crafting recipe
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindRecipeDesc: Use the skill requirements of the weapon's crafting recipe, so anyone who could craft a weapon can customize it. A weapon without a recipe will require a minimum crafting skill for its tech level: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindTechTier: Based on the weapon's tech level ({0})
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindTechTierDesc: Require a minimum crafting skill set by the weapon's tech level, ignoring its crafting recipe: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindFlatDesc: Require at least this crafting skill level for every weapon. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckFlatSliderSelects: Adjusting this slider will select "Minimum crafting skill".
LanguageData.UWU_SkillCheckKindWeaponsmithDesc: Require the weaponsmithing expertise from Vanilla Skills Expanded.
LanguageData.UWU_AllowDefConversionDesc: When enabled, adding a trait to a weapon that is not unique will turn it into its unique version, and removing every trait will turn it back. When disabled, only weapons that are already unique can be customized, and one with no traits left will stay unique. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnableIdeoColorsDesc: Show Ideology and miscellaneous color palettes in the weapon customization color picker. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnableStructureColorsDesc: Show the structure color palette in the weapon customization color picker. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnforceTraitColorsDesc: Some traits, such as gold inlay and tox rounds, set the color of the weapon. When enabled, a weapon with one of these traits will always use that color. When disabled, adding the trait will select its color, but any other color can be picked instead. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnforceMaxTraitLimitDesc: Unique weapons found in the world never have more than three traits. When enabled, the same limit will apply to customization. When disabled, a weapon can have any number of traits that do not conflict. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnforceSoleTraitDesc: Some traits never appear as the only trait on a unique weapon found in the world. When enabled, the same restriction will apply to customization. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_RestrictTraitsToDiscovered: Restrict available traits to discovered weapons
LanguageData.UWU_RestrictTraitsToDiscoveredDesc: When enabled, only traits found on unique weapons on your maps or in your caravans can be added. Weapons hidden by fog, sealed away or carried by hostiles do not count. When disabled, every trait can be added. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_EnableGroundCustomizationDesc: When enabled, right-clicking a weapon on the ground will offer to customize it. When disabled, the right-click menu stays shorter, and weapons can still be customized by selecting them and pressing the Customize button. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.UWU_HaulPlannerSequentialDesc: Colonists will carry one stack of ingredients at a time, taking the nearest first, the same way they do for bills. This is simple and predictable, but expensive customizations will take many short trips.
LanguageData.UWU_HaulPlannerSweepDesc: Colonists will plan ahead, using spare inventory space to carry more at once and taking a shorter route between pickups. This takes far fewer trips than Sequential and has almost no effect on performance.
LanguageData.UWU_HaulPlannerThoroughDesc: Like Sweep, but colonists will also weigh which stacks to take from when there are several to choose from, instead of always taking the closest. This is slower to plan, but will usually find the shortest trips when ingredients are scattered or carrying capacity is tight. It will fall back to Sweep for hauls too complex to analyze fully.
